manifest.fault: The Inline is placed inside a Shape, under an Appearance, as if it were the Shape's geometry.
manifest.viewer_sees: The inlined part never appears; only the marker post is shown.
manifest.spec: error per the X3D standard (Shape has only appearance and geometry fields; Inline is a child node and must sit in a grouping node)

manifest.nearest_prior: P021/P022 are also misplaced nodes but concern Material/Appearance; different node and slot

xsd_errors: Line 20: Element 'Inline': This element is not expected. Expected is one of ( Box, Cone, Cylinder, IndexedFaceSet, IndexedLineSet, IndexedTriangleFanSet, IndexedTriangleSet, IndexedTriangleStripSet, LineSet, PointSet ).

diagnostics.message: Inline containerField='children' but Shape has no field named 'children'. Inline's default containerField is 'children', which does not fit a Shape -- an explicit containerField is required here.
Shape has no geometry child. Add a geometry node like Box, Sphere, or IndexedFaceSet.
